title: 吹爆这款软件
body:
集中汇总式的报表功能非常出彩！一目了然，可以同时看到不同习惯整月整年的完成情况，便于观察和对比，非常直观！因为这个功能入了完整版。
暂时发现了几个需要改进的地方：
1、首先吹一下年度进度的方格居然可以按每天完成量，分不同深浅显示！！！作者太有心了！不过目前在报表中好像还不能显示出来。比如我预定每天完成3，实际今天完成了2，按单个习惯点进去的年进度方格可以看到今天有较浅颜色的打卡，但是报表页面却按照未打卡没有显示，造成不一致。希望报表页面也可以有较浅色显示。
2、进度方格显示，希望能突出显示“今天”在哪格。尤其是年进度显示，不标出来就很难找到“今天”在哪个位置。
3、单个习惯的统计页面，希望能自定义不同图表的位置。因为我不太喜欢看数字统计，比较喜欢看柱状图，每次都要拉到最下面。

title: From a Paying Customer
body:
YEAR LONG UPDATE; I’d have to go and tally on my own (count out day by day) to find out how many times I’ve done something. App is pointless to me as i thought the app would tell me how many times I’ve done something; not make me go back each 365 days and count it up myself. super cool to learn this now that I’ve saved ALL this info in here, for the past year, and the statistics I’m given are totally useless to me / anyone. I’m SUPER skeptical these reviews have been paid for; when I signed up a year ago (in April) there were maybe 800 REVIEWS; NOT 80,000. I don’t know what influencer or viral video set this on fire but I don’t think that really happened. This app looks pretty decent… that’s IT. That’s all it’s good for, for me… but I’ve used it an entire YEAR! Customer service will only email me about how to use the app which is rough because that’s not how I’d like to learn how to use an app… have you ever learned how to use something on your phone… over email? I haven’t either. I bet there’s no YouTube videos on it, considering this app is NOT 80,000 RECIEWS STRONG like that, or popular like that, in any way! My original review when I first started with it; ‘Takes some playing around with to fully understand how to make it work for you. I forget what the cost of membership was but to know how many times I did a certain thing has been worth it. The features I’m not all that into but the interface is really easy to look at.’ 

only reason i got it the app turned out to be a false.

title: Life changing
body:
By using this app everyday I have changed my life. When you're on day 67 of physical exercise and you're feeling tired there is no way you're going to miss a day and go back to zero. If you use this app diligently your life will change 🙌🏾  
I have checked many ritual building apps after reading the life changing "POWER OF FULL ENGAGEMENT" book and this is without doubt the best. Choosing just 6 behaviours makes you focused on actually getting them installed into your life as effortless as brushing your teeth rather than having a huge unmanageable list (as I have done). The feature of having stats for the last month and last 7 days is also exactly on point. Many others give you your stats since the birth of the app which means if you fall off for 4 months you can never get to the rewarding acknowledgment of high percentages. 

Thank you STREAK team for a such a simple, beautiful, elegant and compelling solution to installing rituals into ones life. You are providing a powerful infrastructure for people to make incredible change and do good work in the world. Keep doing what you're doing 🙏🏾✨👊🏾

title: A gem
body: Honestly, this app is just perfect. It does one thing extremely well. I'm always amazed when people complain about an app being too simple. It's just an elegant design and it achieves everything it needs to achieve. And 11 bucks a year or whatever it is seems reasonable for that. It’s a really helpful app. That said, there are a couple ways in which I think the app could be improved. I have one broad feature in mind and one specific feature in mind. Firstly, it would be nice to have some more statistics or visualizations or insight into how you're doing versus the past. Are your relapses getting further and further apart, or are they coming closer together? Just some insight into how this compares to your best ever trend. Maybe resets per month, stuff like that. The second thing is much more simple and concrete. Basically, it would be nice to be able to edit the units without just selecting one. There's an app called Countdown that does this really nicely. You can select each unit independently of the others. So it has every unit from years, quarters, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, and seconds. You know, I might have that slightly wrong, but it's roughly along those lines. And for each unit, you can tick whether to include it or not. In practice, I don't think that people often want to skip a bunch of units. Like, nobody's going to do years and seconds. But it's actually really nice for the widgets. In the app, I think you guys do a great job. For the widget, it would be nice for people who are trying to quit something right at the beginning and they're proud of just getting 5, 10, 15 minutes. But let's say you're trying to not interrupt someone and you're in a meeting. I mean, you might be proud of 20 minutes, but the lowest unit you have is hours. So I think it would just give you guys more flexibility if you keep the app exactly the same. But for the widgets, let people choose how to format the duration string and specifically what units to include. Anyway, thank you for building such a fantastic product. And I really appreciate the time and effort and attention to detail that you put into this product.

title: Great app, but there are a few annoying bugs
body: The most annoying is that for habits to break, in the Progress tab, it always shows 0 for the number of days failed. Under Limit and Longest Streak are also broken. Then, this is minor, but the first week of January 2026 is marked as W1 2025… Finally, this isn’t a bug, but it would be great if the average completion rate for the day didn’t take into account weekly habits (because it should be normal that I’m not gonna work on daily habits every day of the week, and I don’t want to pick specific days because it varies). Great app otherwise, and would certainly be the best habit tracking app if those things were fixed!

title: App keeps getting better
body:
This is by far the best habit tracker in App Store. I have, however, two improvement requests:

1- Add setting to always show best streak. Right now the only way to see the best streak is by having at least three check-ins in a row. Not having that visible at all times is demotivating if you broke the chain and you are trying to recover.

2- Drag and drop from main view. The only way to reorder now is by going to the settings. This is not the best scenario since I am reordering the habits by the effectivity all the time to focus on the ones that need improvement.

PLEASE add those improvements and I will update the review to 5 stars.

title: Love it, almost perfect.
body:
Everything is so concise, neat, and easy to organize. This has been the best app to help me with my crazy ADHD. I am so thankful to the developers seriously.

I'm really hoping for the "Templates" update to the journal, that you will implement some kind of system that automatically creates a recurring note for an individual habit. I have a habit for "Lifting" at the gym. I like that there is an option to add a note with a checklist to it to tick which target areas I did that day. The only thing is I have to recreate the checklist each day. It's so close to being optimal, if templates could automatically recur each day for people with checklists inside of specific habits, and log which items on the checklist were completed while refreshing for the next day, I think this app would be perfect.

Also maybe the ability to hide the streak count for specific habits from the home menu, and capitalized words for the custom units just for neatness sake.

You guys did an amazing job ❤️💕
